summary: Full backend (16 pytest cases) and UI (Playwright) E2E for DoughCast. All 16 backend tests pass; all critical UI flows pass: signup/login/logout, JWT auth, public/protected route guards, log batch dialog updates table, settings auto-save (Saving… → All saved → Auto-saving), forecast hero refresh on settings change, chart renders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); recommend migrating to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.110).

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' AND allow_credentials=True in middleware — browsers reject credentialed wildcard CORS. Currently auth uses Bearer header (no cookies) so it works, but if cookies are ever added this combination will fail. Set explicit origins or set allow_credentials=False.

weather_factor / holiday_factor not mentioned in the docstring of forecast — minor. Predicted formula 'baseline * weather * holiday * conservative' is correct and conservative_factor was verified (0.20 buffer => 0.80 factor).
Dashboard.jsx is ~590 lines — consider splitting (PredictionHero, FlavorMix, SettingsPanel, BatchTable) for maintainability.
Auto-save useEffect serializes settings on every render to compare; works but could memoize. Acceptable for current scale.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (spec mentions 5-fail lockout in playbook). If required, implement an IP/email attempt counter.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env — fine for preview, but flag for production rotation.
test_credentials: Test users were created dynamically via /api/auth/register (e2e-<ts>@doughcast.com / mochi123). /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and accurate.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — each test run registers a fresh user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover health, auth (register/login/me incl. 401 & duplicate), settings (default mochi flavors, partial update persistence, flavors update), batches (create+sorted asc, sold>baked 400, upsert same date, delete + 404 on re-delete), forecast (shape + conservative_factor math), and stats. UI verified: signup uses [data-testid=signup-bakery-input/email-input/password-input]; LogBatchDialog uses batch-baked-input/batch-sold-input/batch-date-input/batch-note-input plus 'Save batch' button. Logout is in the navbar dropdown — open with [data-testid=navbar-user-menu-trigger] then click [data-testid=user-menu-logout]; the welcome toast can briefly cover the trigger so wait ~5s after signup before opening the menu. Save status testid is [data-testid=settings-save-status] and cycles Saving… → All saved → Auto-saving (idle).
